topNews.text: Chihuahua Won’t Stop Pawing at Her Until Owner Finds the Breast Cancer She Smelled
topNews.excerpt: A dog owner says her pooch saved her life, by repeatedly pawing at her armpit, which eventually alerted her to breast cancer. The 61-year-old says her chihuahua Flag started the odd behavior years ago, constantly hitting the underside of her arm with his paw.
